cause: The workflow failed because the pricing mission explicitly raised an order-total-mismatch after requiring orders/place to return a total of 120 for subtotal 100, but the evidence does not show the returned value or the implementations of pricing.rule and pricing.base. Therefore it cannot distinguish which pricing component produced the incorrect total.
evidence: The generated mission source calls orders/place with subtotal 100 and fails unless (get quote "total") equals 120; otherwise it raises {:kind "order-total-mismatch"}.
The execution error records workflow_failed with reason explicit_failure for workflow-evaluation-1.
The orders source defines place as returning total from pricing.tax/add-standard, so the observed failure may originate downstream of orders.
The pricing.tax source delegates add-standard to pricing.rule/apply-standard and pricing.base/amount, but those dependency sources and the actual returned total were not read.
